Past RCA RCA-2024-00088 for API Gateway, completed 2024-10-02. Summary: The wildcard TLS certificate of the edge proxy nodes expired during the night and all clients failed the TLS handshake with the public API.
Root Cause: The wildcard certificate was renewed by hand once a year. The reminder was sent to a former team member and the renewal was missed.
Corrective Actions: Installed a renewed certificate and moved the edge certificates to automatic renewal with cert-manager (CHG-2024-00731). Judged relevant because: Same service (API Gateway) and the symptoms directly match TLS handshake failures, certificate validation errors and partner API call failures. Alike: TLS handshake failures; Certificate validation errors; Partner API calls failing. Different: Root cause was certificate expiration; Remediation added automatic renewal with cert‑manager; Occurred during night after a missed manual renewal. Done then: Installed a renewed certificate and moved the edge certificates to automatic renewal with cert-manager (CHG-2024-00731). Outcome: The renewed certificate restored connections and the automated renewal prevented future expirations. The problem came back after this RCA: it was completed 2024-10-02, before the first incident of this problem (2026-05-01), so its corrective action did not prevent it.

Past API Gateway incident INC-2024-00891, detected 2024-09-18: Gateway clients report handshake failures. Clients could not open secure connections to the public API for about ninety minutes during the night. Symptoms: TLS handshake failures; Partner API calls failing. What was done then: Installed a renewed certificate by hand. Judged relevant because: Same service and reported handshake failures and partner API call failures, matching the current symptoms. Alike: TLS handshake failures; Certificate validation errors; Partner API calls failing. Different: Remediation was only a manual certificate install; No automation of renewal was added; Incident record, not a full RCA analysis. Done then: Installed a renewed certificate by hand. Outcome: Handshake failures were resolved after the manual certificate installation.
